pages.quiz:
HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

2. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   B. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

7. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. C — Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Nairobi

6. B — Plan income and spending wisely

7. B — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. B — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elections in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National integration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Developments in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of African Civilisations up to 19th Century; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
